sequentialTasks.task: S4-fix: Strafe direction correction (A/D keys inverted)
sequentialTasks.description: Hana directive: strafe keys A and D moved the player in the opposite of the expected direction. Root cause: strafe-right vector was inverted relative to screen-right in the view matrix. At yaw=0 the camera looks along +Z; the view-matrix x-axis (screen-right) is (-1,0,0) but the code used (1,0,0). The bug existed identically in server Move(), client movement basis in main.mjs, and camera.right(). All three fixed to use (-cos yaw, sin yaw) matching the view-matrix x-axis.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: D key moves player screen-right; A key moves screen-left; server and client movement agree; zero console errors; genuine evidence.
